content: 1) We consider a practical UAV swarm-assisted vehicle network consisting of multiple low-altitude UAVs and a terrestrial base station (BS) to provide network connectivity services for GVs in city canyon environments, which is a realistic dynamic three-dimensional (3-D) time slice with instantaneous coordinates and velocity vectors.
2) We take the Doppler in the network UAV-GV links as the breakthrough point and derive the mathematical models of the influence on the communication and sensing respectively.
3) We use two Doppler-based performance indicators obtained in 2) to construct the theoretical framework of sensing-communication trade-off and form related optimization problems.

4) We propose a differential evolution (DE)-based approach according to the optimization problem formed in 3). Further, we compare and analyze the proposed design with benchmark methods under the consideration of sensing and communication functional levels respectively.

Input: Number of individuals N_{p}; maximal iterations l_{\text{max}}.Output: Optimal UAV subset selection for ground vehicles \mathbf{V}^{*}.
1:Generate the set \mathcal{O} covering all UAV link selection possibilities.
2:Utilize \mathcal{O} to randomly generate initial population\mathbf{P}_{0} = \{ \mathbf{V}_{0,1}, \dots, \mathbf{V}_{0,N_{p}} \}.
3:for l = 0; l < l_{\text{max}}; l = l + 1 do
4:Calculate the fitness values of the individuals in \mathbf{P}_{l} using Algorithm 1.
5:Use \mathbf{P}_{l} to generate a trial population\dot{\mathbf{P}}_{l} = \{ \dot{\mathbf{V}}_{l,1}, \dots, \dot{\mathbf{V}}_{l,N_{p}} \} according to the mutation and crossover processes of the DE algorithm [28].
6:Calculate the fitness values of the individuals in \dot{\mathbf{P}}_{l} using Algorithm 1 again, and compare with Step 4. One by one to get a new population \mathbf{P}_{l+1} with the selection process in the DE algorithm [28].
7:Select the optimal solution \mathbf{V}^{*} = \mathbf{V}_{l+1,i^{*}}, where i^{*} = \arg\max_{i \in \{1, \dots, N_{p}\}} \text{fit}(\mathbf{V}_{l+1,i}).
8:end for
